Chest.NoOneToSplit: No player logged in has a character set in User Configuration.
Chest.TooLittleToSplit: {silver} s cannot be split among {count} characters.
Chest.OnlyGMDrops: Only the Dark Master can put new items on the scene. Drag one from your character sheet instead.

Vehicle.SpeedHint: Feet per Move action at safe, normal and fast speed. The driver spends their Move actions to move the vehicle.
Vehicle.ArmourHint: Subtracted from collision damage the vehicle takes.
Vehicle.MovingAttack: Attacking from it while it moves: +{normal} DR at normal speed, +{fast} DR at fast speed, not possible at safe speed. Add it in the attack dialogue.
Vehicle.AboardHint: Drag characters, minions or foes from the Actors sidebar onto this sheet. The driver rolls the driving tests; everyone aboard takes collision damage.
Vehicle.NobodyAboard: Nobody. Drag characters, minions or foes here from the Actors sidebar.
Vehicle.StrappedHint: A seatbelt or the likes: halves collision damage, and is not thrown in a fast crash.
Vehicle.DriveTooltip: Choose the speed and what the driver does; the driver tests Agility when the table needs it.
Vehicle.DriveHint: Driving at safe or normal speed needs no test. A Triumph gives Boon on the next driving test this encounter.
Vehicle.NoDriver: Nobody is driving {name}. Drag a character onto its sheet and set the role to Driver.
Vehicle.NotYourDriver: You do not own {name}, the driver.
Vehicle.BoonFromTriumph: Boon from the last driving Triumph.

Outcome.triumph: You thread the gap perfectly: the vehicle moves as you wish, and you have Boon on your next driving test this encounter.
Outcome.success: The vehicle moves as you wish.
Outcome.failure: You lose control for a moment. The vehicle moves only half its speed ({feet}′), in a direction the Dark Master chooses.
Outcome.ruin: You crash. The vehicle stops dead or overturns.

Vehicle.ProneTests: Everyone aboard tests Agility DR{dr} or is knocked Prone.
Vehicle.PronePurpose: Staying on your feet as the vehicle loses control (a Failure or Ruin knocks you Prone).
Vehicle.FoeDecides: {name}: foes do not roll; the Dark Master decides.
Vehicle.CollisionHalf: It clips an obstacle: half the collision damage. Collision {formula}: {rolled}.
Vehicle.CollisionFull: The vehicle and everyone aboard take the full collision damage. Collision {formula}: {rolled}.
Vehicle.DarkMasterMoves: The Dark Master moves the vehicle.
Vehicle.NoCargo: Nothing. Drag items here from a character (they move) or from the Items sidebar.
Vehicle.PassengerSeatsHint: How many passengers it carries, such as 6 for the steam wagon. Each one aboard with the Passenger role takes cargo limit ÷ seats of cargo room (rounded up).
Vehicle.CargoLimitHint: How many heavy (cumbersome) items it carries, such as 20 for the steam wagon. Above it the vehicle is Encumbered, above twice it the vehicle cannot move. 0: no limit written down, nothing is counted.
Vehicle.LoadHint: Heavy (cumbersome) cargo counts once per piece; each passenger takes {room}. Driver and crew take no room. Above the limit: Encumbered (safe speed only, Bane on driving tests). Above twice the limit: it cannot move.
Vehicle.EncumberedNote: Encumbered ({used}/{limit}): safe speed only, and Bane on the driving test.
Vehicle.Overloaded: {name} carries {used} against a limit of {limit}: more than twice it, so it cannot move.
Vehicle.NotCargo: {item} cannot be carried as cargo. Vehicles take weapons, armour, shields, gear, containers, scrolls and relics, and feats as special rules.
Vehicle.CannotMove: You must own both {from} and where {item} is going to move it.

Improving.Tooltip: Improving (rules 2.8): roll for each ability, a feat, more HP and a find. The Dark Master decides when.
Improving.Ask: Improve {name} now? Each ability rolls a d6, then 6d10 for more HP and a d6 on the find table. Afterwards the player chooses a feat or power.
Improving.AskRandom: Improve {name} now? Each ability rolls a d6, a d3 rolls the feat or power, then 6d10 for more HP and a d6 on the find table.
Improving.Title: {name} improves
Improving.HpFixedNow: Max HP no longer follows Toughness from now on: Improving fixes it.

Step.find: IV. Amidst shadowed crevices you find…

Improving.FeatCard: Choose or roll for one general feat, or one feat or power of your ancestry or class, and drop it on your sheet. A feat is marked “Gained through Improving”.
Improving.FeatNone: No feat or power is left to roll: choose one by hand and drop it on the sheet.
Improving.ChooseGroup: Choose the group the new feat or power comes from. One is rolled from that group.
Improving.GroupEmpty: {die}: {roll} → {group}, but none is left to gain: rolled again → {next}.
Improving.FeatRolled: Gains the feat {item}, marked “Gained through Improving”.
Improving.RollFeatTooltip: Roll a d3 for a general feat, or a feat or power of your ancestry or class, and gain one at random

Group.ancestry: a feat or power of your ancestry
Group.class: a feat or power of your class

Improving.HpGain: 6d10: {total}, at least max HP {max}. Max HP and HP go up by d6: {gain} (max HP {newMax}).
Improving.HpNone: 6d10: {total}, below max HP {max}. No more HP.

Method.individualHint: Roll 3d6 for each ability. The Ability Score Table turns each roll sum into a score from −3 to +3.

Class.SpellHint: Learn one spell from the {list} list, costing at most {cost} 🟒. Further spells are learned from spell tomes.
Class.Hint: You begin with your class feature and class power, and nothing more (rules 2.5); both are set by the class and added with it. The class's other feats and powers are earned through Improving.

Class.NotFound: {name} is not in the compendiums: add it by hand.

Target.chanceSplit: Chance Die without Neutral: Positive from

Target.spellArmourMaxTier: No spellcasting Bane in metal armour up to tier
Target.soakPerWound: Natural armour of one tier per wound, up to tier

Effects.RerollOnesHint: Damage dice that show 1 are rolled again once (Hawkeye).

Event.longRest: After a Long Rest or Downtime
